title: Law to extend J-51 tax break for building repairs
summary: This bill would extend the J-51 property tax abatement to alterations and improvements completed between June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2036. Eligible buildings include co-ops and condos with average assessed value under $60,000 per unit, buildings where more than half the units are affordable, buildings run by limited-profit housing companies, and buildings receiving substantial government assistance. Owners could recover up to 100% of certified costs over 20 years, subject to tenant protections and HPD reporting requirements.
